intuition: Only open cells connected to the border can avoid capture; all other open cells are enclosed.

brute_force.approach: For every open cell, search its component and determine whether it touches a border.

optimal.approach: Mark open cells reachable from the border, flip unmarked open cells, and restore marked cells.

edge_cases: A one-row or one-column board has no enclosed open region.
An open region touching any border must remain unchanged.
